scope: Line-by-line repository and table-row verification across all rendered pages, JSON data artifacts, and CI/CD workflows

files_reviewed.notes: Generates /, /picks/, /edge/, /twc-picks/, /coverage/, /methodology/, /review/, data/picks.csv, and data/row-source-audit.json; enforces link checking and non-blocking row-source audit.
Generates /origination/ with mobile-first cards, filter tabs, full match table (#picks), unresolved picks & limitations table (#unresolved), and alias registry (#aliases).
Generates /strategy/ leaderboard plan with contrarian underdog rules (>=35% model/market win probability and >=4pp edge over Hotspawn crowd share).

Executes the 5-rung non-Hotspawn origination ladder: consensus -> market (Polymarket, Kalshi) -> bookmaker (Thunderpick, Bovada) -> reference (EGamersWorld published bookmaker average) -> model (Valve official ratings).
Verifies SHA-256 excerpt hashes, decimal odds > 1.01, overround in [0.85, 1.35], and proportional de-vigging before emitting a reference quote.
Audits every HTML <tr> and pick card across all built pages to guarantee every row carries either a verified external source link or an explicit unverified/review link.
Runs on 4-hour cron, workflow_dispatch, and push to main; refreshes data, replays all evidence hashes, builds site, deploys to GitHub Pages, and verifies live HTTP 200 responses.
